snippet.title: Chess of the Hidden Gates — Official Trailer | Roguelike Deckbuilder × Chinese Chess
snippet.description:
A roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a Chinese chess move. Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4981020/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=trailer

The world is a board; everything is a piece. Outmaneuver ancient spirits square by square — victory takes more than raw power. It takes position.

Breach the Eight Gates. Face the Nine Stars. Play, or be taken.

▸ 125 cards across four rarities — every card a move, a kill, or a trap
▸ Three classes, three signature systems: Momentum burst, Steadfast defense, Relay artillery
▸ Thirty-odd beasts, each with a backstory and a mechanic of its own
▸ Nine Star bosses across three acts, every one rewriting the rules
▸ Reshuffled every run — no two games alike

Coming Q4 2026.

#roguelike #deckbuilder #indiegame #chess #cardgame
